description: Entrepreneurship teaches how new businesses start: what entrepreneurs do, the skills they need, learning from someone who started a business, generating and choosing an idea, writing a business plan, and thinking through success, problems and ethics.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.summary: What entrepreneurship is and its role in the economy.

requirements.title: Skills of an entrepreneur
requirements.summary: Why skills such as communication, planning and leadership matter to entrepreneurs.

requirements.title: Interviewing an entrepreneur
requirements.summary: Interviewing someone who started a business and discussing what you learned.

requirements.title: Business ideas
requirements.summary: Brainstorming ideas, narrowing them down and choosing the best one.

requirements.summary: A plan covering your product, market, finances, people and marketing.

requirements.title: Running the business
requirements.summary: Likely successes, problems and ethical questions once the business is running.
